description: Library functions for CSV serialization and deserialization, including file handling and recordset management within the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADORecordSet
classes.description: Class representing a recordset, used for handling database query results.

classes.name: ADOFieldObject
classes.description: Class representing a database field object, used for defining column metadata.

methods.name: _rs2serialize
methods.description: Converts a recordset into a CSV serialization format.

methods.name: csv2rs
methods.description: Reads a CSV file or URL and converts it into a recordset object.

methods.name: adodb_write_file
methods.description: Writes contents to a file with file locking and optional debugging.
